newsitem.title: USA: Dow poised for run at 6000, profit-taking looms.
newsitem.headline: Dow poised for run at 6000, profit-taking looms.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to face early profit-taking on Monday after last week's rally but analysts said the Dow industrials should manage a challenge of the 6000 level later in the day.
"We'll probably see some early profit-taking," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. "But later in the session the market will make a stab at 6000."
Oil stocks were likely to lend early strength to the Dow industrials after a report that several industry giants are discussing a merger of their U.S. downstream operations.
